By: Dorthy Victor, Emily Kay, and Janvi Balakrishnan

Growth Score Calculator

Growth Score: on a scale of 0 to 100, it evaluates the potential career growth a job offers using the average of 7 different metrics:

  • Salary
  • Culture and Diversity ratings
  • Career Opportunities provided
  • Job Openings
  • How likely you are to get promoted
  • Work-life balance score
  • Burnout rate (lower = better)

Enter the job you're applying for

 
Paste the posting text, then press "Fill the fields from this text", or type the details in.

What matters most to you

Rate each one from 1 (matters a little) to 5 (matters a lot). The score updates as you move the sliders.
